items.title: Validation error on 3D examples

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

items.body:
## Bevy version
4ce37395da029eb8b58c78c32812fe8329a3a1a4

## \[Optional\] Relevant system information

If you cannot get Bevy to build or run on your machine, please include:
Rust version: 1.69.0
Linux 6.3.5-arch1-1, Gnome (tried both on Wayland and Xorg)
```
AdapterInfo { name: "NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050", vendor: 4318, device: 7309, device_type: DiscreteGpu, driver: "NVIDIA", driver_info: "530.41.03", backend: Vulkan }
```
## What you did
`cargo run --example 3d_shapes`
## What went wrong
Got an error:
```
2023-06-01T04:49:14.980085Z ERROR wgpu_hal::vulkan::instance: VALIDATION [UNASSIGNED-CoreValidation-Shader-InconsistentSpirv (0x6bbb14)]
	Validation Error: [ UNASSIGNED-CoreValidation-Shader-InconsistentSpirv ] Object 0: handle = 0x55d1a59495d0, type = VK_OBJECT_TYPE_DEVICE; | MessageID = 0x6bbb14 | SPIR-V module not valid: [VUID-StandaloneSpirv-OpTypeRuntimeArray-04680] Vulkan, OpTypeStruct containing an OpTypeRuntimeArray must be decorated with Block or BufferBlock.
  %PointLights = OpTypeStruct %_runtimearr_PointLight

```
The program seems to run completely fine and everything looks correct.

## Additional information
running `cargo run --example sprite` for example doesn't have any errors, only the 3d examples (tested `3d_shapes`, `3d_rotation` and `3d_scene`)
